newsitem.title: USA: NCS Healthcare files for 3.25 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: NCS Healthcare files for 3.25 mln shares.

text.p: NCS Healthcare Inc filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 3.25 million class A common shares.
Of the total, the company said it will offer 3.0 million shares, while shareholders may offer up to 250,000 shares.
Net proceeds wil be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions and debt repayment, the company said.
After the offering, the company will have 9,098,690 class A common shares outstanding and 6,445,819 class B common stock outstanding, it said.

The offering will be made through Smnith Barney Inc, William Blair & Co, Montgomery Securities and McDonald & Co Securities Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 487,500 additional shares.
